messages:
linh: Quick async — planning to enable EU-WEST-2 routing for tenant traffic next Tue. Need to confirm owners for KMS residency config, outbound firewall rules, and the routing policy change. Who's owning KMS key rotation/tests?

matt: I can take KMS ownership for EU-WEST-2 but need a hand with the IAM role bindings. @sara can you review the cross-account policy?

sara: Yup, I can review. Can you paste the proposed IAM snippet?

alex: FYI networking asked us to add the following to the routing policy to prefer local region:

```
route_policy "prefer_local" {
  match: region == "eu-west-2"
  prefer: eu-west-2
  fallback: global
}
```

linh: thanks — that looks right. @alex can you also confirm whether health-checks need an additional port (we only use 9001 currently)?

alex: health-checks need 9001 + 9100 for the KV cache exporter. I'll file a tiny PR to add 9100 to the SGs.

matt: opened PR 7312 for KMS role changes, pinging @sara for review. small diff: adjust trust policy for the inference-service role.

sara: reviewing now. quick comment: the role ARN uses the prod account, should be eu account. leaving inline comment.

security: quick note from security review — for EU residency we need audit_logging:enabled + explicit S3 bucket residency tag. Also ensure HSM-backed KMS if any regulated tenant.

linh: great catch. @matt can you add audit logging toggle and bucket tag to the KMS PR? we'll need to coordinate with storage team for tag propagation.

matt: yep will add. Also, is there an expected rollout window? ops wants a two-hour maintenance window for the SG changes.

linh: Targeting Tue 03:00 UTC -> 05:00 UTC. Ops will do a phased canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. @deploy-bot can you schedule the canary for Tue 03:15 UTC?

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 2071303200 (Tue 03:15 UTC). Notifying oncall.

alex: I've got the SG PR up (net/psg-209). tagging ops for merge during the maintenance window.

linh: Action items summary: 1) @matt add audit tag + HSM flag to PR 7312, 2) @sara finish IAM review, 3) @alex finalize SG PR and confirm health ports, 4) security to confirm HSM requirement list, 5) ops/deploy-bot to run canary Tue 03:15 UTC. If anyone can't meet these, call it out here by EOD PST. :thumbsup:

sara: can do, will finish review by EOD.

matt: on it, will push updates in ~90m.

security: we'll send HSM checklist in this thread by EOD.

linh: thanks all — I'll post a short confluence note after releases are green.
